external_review.overall_explanation: No actionable defects were found in the reviewed change bundle. The implemented boundaries consistently enforce trace provenance and window validation, hidden-data quarantine, candidate source validation before execution, per-trial policy reloading, restricted import facades, trusted-only result serialization, bounded Docker output handling, cleanup on failure, and unchanged prefix-hash semantics. The accompanying tests cover the previously identified bypasses and failure modes at their relevant ownership boundaries.

preflight.host_container_parity: exact scores, identities, and per-request hit lengths

conclusion: The bounded search produced no evolved policy that improved the unchanged parent. TinyLFU-LRU remained strongest on visible and hidden production traffic.
limitations: The one-hour wall budget allowed only three evaluator attempts, so this is a shallow search.
The trace is one production capture with chronological holdouts, not independent sessions.
The trace omits tenant, session, priority, model, tool-DAG, and content fields.
Output-length pinning and latency values are simulator proxies, not serving measurements.
Every time window starts with cold policy and cache state.
The result supports production tool-and-agent traffic only; it is not specific to coding agents.
Chronological separation does not establish session or tenant independence.
Prefixes and sessions can recur across windows; policy/cache state resets.
Validation is visible to evolution; hidden is reserved for final evaluation.
Omitted gaps and cold starts change the serving state of the original capture.
Arrival buckets and output-length pinning are proxies, not measured latency.

search.privacy: OpenAI received policy source, mutation instructions, and aggregate visible feedback. Raw trace records and credentials were not sent.

selection.reason: The final retained archive contained only the unchanged parent. The sole evaluated mutation scored 30.674962004096216 and was rejected; no evolved candidate beat the parent on visible validation.
selection.selection_rule: highest charged visible-validation score among successful final archive elites with zero invalid fraction and effective complexity <= 650; lower complexity then source SHA-256 break exact ties
